label: Local download recipes — AMS ship pair + optional tools. App Download button pulls AMS GGUF/ONNX when HF allows.

items.name: ASI AMS Micro 70M (router)
items.hardwareHint: CPU / Pi / 8 GB laptop — no GPU required
installSteps: Click Download in Settings → Models → Downloads (or run npm run install:ams).
Gated HF repo: set HF_TOKEN (or hf auth login) and accept access on https://huggingface.co/vvarghese/ams-micro-70m.
Product ONNX basename is ams-micro-70m.onnx (~68.15M → brand 70M). Install renames to that name even if HF still lists a legacy training filename.
Run node scripts/verify-ams-gguf.mjs — status must be installed (ONNX on disk or GGUF).
items.notes: Default on-device intent router (:7821). Classifier — not a chat LLM. Matching ONNX marks installed with ONNX on disk badge (not claimed as GGUF). GGUF recipe stays uninstalled until a real .gguf exists. Reference router is still Ollama/llama.cpp.

items.name: ASI AMS Hybrid 120M (router)
items.hardwareHint: Prefer 8+ GB system RAM; CPU OK
installSteps: Click Download or run npm run install:ams -- --id ams-hybrid-120m.
Product ONNX: ams-hybrid-120m.onnx (~116.07M → brand 120M). Never map Micro ONNX here.
Or place matching Hybrid weights into models/ams/, Scan, then verify.
items.notes: Optional larger local router (legacy showcase-132m / q3x training lineage). Weights not shipped in git; local/HF ONNX marks installed honestly.

items.name: ASI AMS Agent Chat (~50–100M)
installSteps: Obtain agent-chat GGUF when available from https://huggingface.co/vvarghese.
Filename must include agent-chat or agentchat.
items.notes: Advanced / non-ship. Short on-device specialist replies.

items.name: Ultra gate ~1M
installSteps: Optional experiment weights only — never assign as ship brain.
Filename must include ultra-gate or ultragate.

items.name: Whisper (Ollama)
items.notes: After pull, Whisper appears in Ollama model list (also probed by GET /api/models when Ollama is up).

items.name: Whisper GGUF (llama.cpp)
items.notes: Download a Whisper .gguf from Hugging Face into models/custom, then Scan in Browse.

items.name: Docling (PDF / Office parser)
items.notes: Parse PDFs and exports to markdown — run beside agents, not inside GGUF scan.

items.name: Tesseract OCR (Python)
items.notes: Requires Tesseract binary installed on Windows (UB Mannheim build).

items.name: python-pptx (deck builder)
items.notes: Programmatic .pptx creation — pair with a chat model for slide content.
